This is Adyen
Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.
For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
Senior Technical Recruiter
We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Recruiter to join our Global Talent Acquisition team and drive the growth of our North American teams, specifically in our San Francisco office. Our company empowers you to implement your ideas, take ownership of your career, and continuously learn.

You'll experience a fast-paced, open-minded work environment that fosters innovation and collaboration. As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you will collaborate closely with our hiring teams to spot, attract, and hire top talent, playing a pivotal role in shaping the future of our growing organization.

You have a minimum of 7 years experience in Technical Recruitment - expertise in hiring for Engineering, Product, Design and/or Data focused roles preferred;
Passionate about Recruitment with a deep understanding of the tech landscape and candidate market; Fintech/Payments experience and knowledge of the local SF market is greatly appreciated!
Utilize analytics to inform hiring strategies and improve recruitment outcomes;
Highly self-motivated with the ability to define structure and prioritize tasks effectively;
Deep knowledge of recruitment sourcing strategies and ability to nurture a passive candidate talent pool
Additional Information
The annual base salary range for this role is $145,000 - $195,000; to learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click here .
This role is based out of our San Francisco office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.
Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments
Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.
Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!
What’s next?
Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.
Adyen is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations.

Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide.

Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere
We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.
We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

Remote - United Kingdom
From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere!
We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there.

Sardine is hiring across EMEA, and technical hiring is a core requirement for how fast we can build. As our Technical Recruiter for EMEA, you'll own full-cycle hiring for engineering, data, ML, and product roles in those regions - from first conversation with a hiring manager to signed offer. This is a build-it role, not a maintain-it one.

You'll be shaping how we source and assess technical talent in markets where we're still establishing a presence, and you'll have real influence over process, tooling, and how candidates experience us.

Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for Technical roles, including Software Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning and Product across EMEA.
Partner with hiring managers to define job requirements, create job descriptions, and develop a clear hiring strategy for each role.
Source, screen, and interview candidates through various channels, including job boards, social media, networking, and direct outreach.
Provide an exceptional candidate experience, from initial contact through to offer discussion.
Drive offer management and ensure a seamless candidate-to-hire process.

5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruitment, with at least 3+ years in a high-growth tech startup environment.
Proven experience recruiting technical roles in a B2B SaaS company.
Hands-on experience with recruiting in EMEA markets.
Strong understanding of recruiting for fast-paced environments with the ability to balance multiple priorities.
A passion for data-driven recruiting and a strong comfort with ATS (Ashby preferred), Notion, and reports.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels of the organization.
Experience working with diverse, international teams and understanding the nuances in hiring across different geographies and cultures.
High energy, hands-on approach with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment.
A genuine passion for people, talent, and creating a great company culture.

Do you get excited about helping drivers land their next opportunity? US 1 Shorthaul is looking for a recruiter who thrives in a fast-moving environment and takes pride in connecting CDL and driver candidates with career opportunities that can make a meaningful impact on their lives. This role is centered on driver recruiting .

The person in this seat will spend the vast majority of their time recruiting, screening, and guiding CDL and driver candidates through the hiring process. This is not a broad recruiting role with a light driver component.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with drivers, understands the importance of the details, and can keep hiring momentum moving in a high-priority environment. The right person will be proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and strong with follow-through.

They will be comfortable working across multiple systems, maintaining accurate records, and helping ensure candidates meet minimum hiring and safety requirements. While recruiters have assigned sites and core ownership, this team works with a shared-support mindset.

We partner closely, communicate openly, and step in to help one another when priorities shift or workloads spike. The right person will be able to take ownership of their work while also contributing as a strong team player.

Key Responsibilities: Recruit primarily for CDL and driver positions Communicate with candidates by phone, email, and recruiting platforms Build relationships with driver candidates and guide them through the hiring process from first contact through next steps Screen candidates carefully to confirm qualifications, work history, and minimum safety requirements Utilize multiple systems and tools to track applicants, verify information, and maintain accurate candidate records Coordinate candidate movement through the hiring process in a timely and organized manner Maintain detailed notes, strong follow-up, and clear communication throughout the process Partner with internal leaders regarding hiring priorities, candidate status, and recruiting progress Team-oriented mindset with the ability to own assigned sites while also stepping in to support broader team priorities when needed Help create a positive candidate experience and strong first impression of US 1 Shorthaul What We’re Looking For: Experience in transportation, CDL, or driver recruiting (preferred) Strong attention to detail and the ability to catch small issues before they become bigger problems Highly proactive work style with strong ownership and urgency Excellent communication and follow-through Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Comfort using multiple systems to track candidate progress and hiring activity Ability to work independently while staying aligned with team and business needs Someone who genuinely enjoys driver recruiting and is energized by a detail-heavy, fast-paced environment Why this role matters: At US 1 Shorthaul , every hire matters.

We are looking for someone who will create a positive experience for candidates while helping us bring in safe, qualified drivers who fit how we operate. About US 1 Shorthaul : US 1 Shorthaul supports transportation and logistics operations across the country, with a strong focus on safety, service, and reliability.

We are looking for team members who communicate well, move with urgency, and take pride in the impact their work makes.

Benefits and Perks: Weekly Pay Paid Time Off Health Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance 401(k) with Company Match Employer-Paid Life Insurance Employer-Paid AD&D Insurance Additional voluntary benefits Apply now to join the US 1 Shorthaul team! US 1 Shorthaul is an Equal Employment Opportunity ("EEO") Employer.

In keeping with our commitment, we welcome all to apply including veterans and individuals with disabilities.

US 1 Shorthaul does not discriminate against employees or applicants on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristic prohibited by federal, state, and/or local laws. #zr Originally posted on Himalayas

We deliver reliable solutions for homeowners while empowering our teams to grow, lead, and make a lasting impact. To be a Spartan means to lead with purpose, embrace challenges, and create meaningful change.

Our mission is driven by innovation, integrity, and a commitment to excellence in solar energy. Join our community of professionals shaping the future of clean energy, where every project reflects our promise of Solar Done Right.

Bilingual Recruiter (English/Spanish) Fully Remote | $55,000–$60,000 per year SpartanX is looking for a Bilingual Recruiter who knows how to find exceptional talent in the electrical and construction industries.

If you have experience recruiting electricians, construction professionals, or skilled trades—and solar recruiting is in your toolbox—we want to talk to you. This is a fully remote position supporting hiring efforts across multiple U.S. markets.

You'll partner with hiring managers to recruit top talent while helping build the workforce that powers one of the fastest-growing industries in the country.

What You'll Do Recruit electricians, apprentices, construction professionals, and skilled trades talent Source candidates using Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals, social media, and networking Conduct phone screens and virtual interviews in both English and Spanish Manage multiple open requisitions while maintaining an exceptional candidate experience Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs Partner with hiring managers to understand staffing priorities Maintain accurate applicant tracking records and recruiting metrics Extend offers and coordinate with the HR and onboarding teams What We're Looking For Fluent in English and Spanish (written and verbal) Previous recruiting experience in electrical, construction, or skilled trades Solar industry recruiting experience is a strong plus Experience managing full-cycle recruiting Strong sourcing and interviewing skills Ability to prioritize multiple positions and meet hiring deadlines Experience using ATS platforms and major job boards Excellent communication and relationship-building skills Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment What We Offer $55,000–$60,000 annual salary Fully remote position Monday–Friday schedule Opportunity to recruit for a growing national company Supportive, collaborative team environment Opportunities for career growth and advancement If you're a recruiter who understands the skilled trades, enjoys finding hard-to-fill talent, and thrives in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help us build the teams that keep SpartanX growing. Solar Done Right. Legal Disclaimer SpartanX is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values workplace diversity.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability. For more information, please visit www.eeoc.gov. Originally posted on Himalayas

We are looking for an energetic HR and Recruitment Specialist to take ownership of talent acquisition and help shape the HR department. Your time will be split roughly 6 0/40 between recruitment and Learning & Development . On one side, you'll own talent acquisition end-to-end — finding, attracting and hiring great people.

On the other, you'll build our L&D function from the ground up: as a growing startup we don't yet have a Learning & Development framework in place, and creating one will be your responsibility.

It's an ideal opportunity for someone who genuinely enjoys the hunt for talent and the challenge of designing development programmes from scratch — a builder who wants real ownership of both hiring and people development within a supportive, fast-moving team.

Working hours ~15:00 - 00:00 (mid-shift) Fully remote environment This opportunity is open only to candidates based in the Philippines (Manila) Key Responsibilities: Recruitment Manage the full recruitment life-cycle — from role intake and job advert writing through sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer and close.

Proactively source candidates for Finance, Procurement and Data roles across LinkedIn, JobStreet, Indeed, social media, referrals and talent-pool databases. Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements, agree candidate profiles and keep searches on track.

Screen CVs, conduct initial interviews and coordinate the interview process end-to-end for a great candidate experience. Manage offers, background checks and pre-employment requirements; keep the applicant tracking system and pipeline reports up to date.

Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs, including passive candidates.

Configure, set up and test recruitment software and systems as we build out our tooling Learning & Development (build it from the ground up) Design and build our Learning & Development framework from scratch — as a growing startup, we don't yet have one, and this is yours to own.

Develop training and development programmes across onboarding, core skills, leadership and role-specific upskilling. Assess training needs across teams and translate them into practical, scalable learning initiatives. Source, design or facilitate workshops and learning content, and measure their impact as the business grows.

Establish the foundations — competency frameworks, learning pathways and development planning — that will scale with the company. HR Deliver a smooth onboarding experience for new hires and support their first-weeks integration. Support day-to-day HR operations — employee records, contracts, HR queries and general people support.

Contribute to employer-branding and engagement activities that make us a great place to work.

Requirements Required Skills & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business or a related field - mandatory Fluent in English (verbal and written) - mandatory 2–5 years' experience in recruitment / talent acquisition, with exposure to broader HR and L&D. A proven track record of sourcing and hiring across a range of roles.

Exposure to designing or delivering L&D / training programmes — and the initiative to build a framework from scratch in a startup environment. Hands-on experience with job boards and sourcing tools popular in the Philippines. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Confident with technology and Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint). Strong organisation and the ability to juggle multiple vacancies and priorities at once. Based in or around Metro Manila. Highlights [add Denova description] Originally posted on Himalayas

A dedicated Sourcing & Recruitment Coordinator handles sourcing, candidate emails, and scheduling — so your day is spent on what requires real judgment: reviewing, interviewing, and endorsing. Comfortable working US hours, with flexibility across regions.

About Radiant
Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the world’s first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling.

Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases.

Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials.

Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.

Radiant is seeking a driven recent grad to join our talent team and help build the engineering teams behind Kaleidos, our portable, mass-producible nuclear microreactor targeting commercial deployment in 2028.

This is a role for someone who wants to start a career in recruitment, work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with real ownership and influence, build a deep tech career, and learn about several technical domains like nuclear, hardware, electrical, software, and more.

We are seeking a highly skilled Recruiter to join our Go To Market (GTM) Talent Acquisition team in the United States.

This individual will bring deep sourcing capability, strong market insights, and proven recruiting experience to identify and engage top talent across strategic roles, with a focus on Customer and Go-to-Market functions (Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Support).

The ideal candidate brings experience building talent pipelines through proactive outreach, targeted market research, and thoughtful partnership with hiring managers, while delivering a high-touch candidate and stakeholder experience throughout the recruiting process.
This is a six-month remote contract role based in the United States.

Full-Cycle Recruiting: Manage the full recruitment lifecycle across multiple roles and business units, partnering closely with hiring managers to drive search strategy, candidate engagement, interview process management and offer execution
Strategic Sourcing: Proactively identify and engage top talent through advanced sourcing techniques, including Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter Gem, Greenhouse, referrals, and professional networking. Build pipelines of qualified talent with a strong focus on passive candidates and hard-to-reach profiles
Candidate Experience: Deliver a high-touch, highly responsive candidate experience from initial outreach through offer stage, ensuring clear communication, strong follow-through, and a professional representation of the MongoDB brand
Market Mapping & Talent Intelligence: Develop a clear view of talent markets, industry trends, and hiring dynamics to shape search strategy and inform hiring decisions
Stakeholder Partnership: Partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders to align on role requirements, candidate profiles, search strategy, and market realities. Operate with a high degree of ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to move searches forward with limited oversight
Operational Excellence: Maintain strong data accuracy and process discipline across recruiting systems, using metrics and pipeline insights to drive decisions, track progress, and improve efficiency

Professional Experience: 5+ years of full life cycle recruiting experience, with at least one year of hands on technical recruiting exposure
Sourcing Expertise: Demonstrated success sourcing and engaging talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, CRM/ATS tools, and market research. Proven ability to build pipelines beyond active applicants.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage candidates and stakeholders professionally and effectively.
Technology & Market Acumen: Strong understanding of the technology landscape, with the ability to quickly learn complex technical concepts, understand talent competitors, and translate market insight into effective recruiting strategy.
Stakeholder Management: Experience partnering with hiring managers and senior stakeholders across multiple searches, balancing competing priorities while maintaining a high standard of execution.
A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Drive sourcing for multiple domains within our APAC hiring region, leveraging innovative sourcing strategies to attract top talent and ensure hiring goals are met.

Manage pipeline activity, maintain data integrity, and provide data-driven updates to stakeholders to inform decisions.

Translate hiring manager needs into clear, actionable search strategies.
Understand the talent landscape and map companies, teams, talent clusters, and candidate movement.
Craft compelling, personalized, and relevant outreach that improves response rates - while keeping communications human, inclusive, and role-relevant.

5+ years sourcing for tough to fill roles.
Proven track record of engaging passive candidates, building diverse pipelines, and providing inclusive candidate experiences.
A data-driven mindset and approach to diagnose issues, prioritize work, and communicate tradeoffs, risks, and insights.
Ability to work in a fluid environment while staying flexible, and organized along the way

Quick to ramp on new recruiting tools and workflows (e.g., ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter, sourcing platforms, and scheduling tools).
The ability to use AI as a partner and not a decision maker. Clear understanding of how to use AI responsibly with privacy, inclusion, and candidate experience in mind.
Fluency in both Business Mandarin and English is required for business purposes.

s.h: TALENT ACQUISITION SOURCER II / SENIOR – TEMPORARY
s.t:
Rocket Lab is on a mission to redefine access to space, and we need exceptional talent to get there. As a Talent Acquisition Sourcer , based on-site at Rocket Lab Headquarters in Long Beach, CA, you’ll be at the forefront of building the teams that drive our innovation.

This strategic, hands-on sourcing position involves partnering closely with production department recruiters and leaders to define candidate profiles, develop innovative search strategies, and build pipelines of both active and passive candidates.
We seek a career Sourcer with experience identifying top-tier talent for complex technical and engineering roles in fast-paced manufacturing environments. In this role you will leverage advanced sourcing tools to uncover hard-to-find talent in aerospace, defense, and cutting-edge technology.

If you have deep expertise with sourcing platforms, a passion for connecting with passive candidates, and the drive to operate with urgency and creativity, you’ll feel right at home here. In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to shape this role and make a huge impact on our sourcing strategies and capabilities!
*This is a 6-month fixed-term role for immediate hire, with the potential opportunity to convert to full-time employment upon term completion. This role sits onsite at our Long Beach, CA headquarters – remote work is not considered for this position.
*Please note this position can be hired at the Talent Acquisition Sourcer II or Senior Talent Acquisition Sourcer I level.

Lead strategic sourcing initiatives for technical roles, utilizing advanced sourcing tools and techniques, including LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, Indeed, and niche industry platforms.
Own search strategy development, proactive outreach campaigns, and initial candidate assessments to ensure a consistent flow of high-quality candidates.
Engage and convert passive candidates through creative outreach, referral campaigns, and relationship building, while promoting Rocket Lab’s employer brand.
Build and maintain robust talent pipelines for hard-to-fill, niche, or high-priority roles, ensuring long-term alignment with future hiring needs.
Conduct high-level candidate screening and interviews, assessing skills, motivations, and cultural fit to achieve strong interview-to-offer ratios.
Provide market intelligence and talent mapping, offering insights into talent availability, competitor trends, and compensation benchmarks.
Collaborate closely with recruiters and hiring managers to define candidate personas, calibrate search efforts, and provide timely updates on pipeline progress.
Champion diversity sourcing strategies and ensure an outstanding candidate experience at every touchpoint.
Contribute to recruitment marketing efforts, including social media outreach, university events, and talent community engagement.
Track and report on key sourcing metrics, continuously optimizing processes and strategies for better outcomes.
YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A TALENT ACQUISITION SOURCER II:
2+ years of full-time experience as a dedicated Talent Acquisition Sourcer, within aerospace, defense, technology, or other high growth industry and a bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of work experience (6+ years total experience).
Proven expertise sourcing for technical and niche engineering roles.
Advanced proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, Indeed, and other sourcing platforms and strategies.
Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) such as Greenhouse, Lever, Workday Recruiting, or similar.
Track record of building pipelines for passive candidates through creative sourcing, networking, and engagement campaigns.
YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A SENIOR TALENT ACQUISITION SOURCER I:
5+ years of full-time experience as a dedicated Talent Acquisition Sourcer, within aerospace, defense, technology, or other high growth industry and a bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of work experience (9+ years total experience).
Proven expertise sourcing for technical and niche engineering roles.
Advanced proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, Indeed, and other sourcing platforms and strategies.
Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) such as Greenhouse, Lever, Workday Recruiting, or similar.
Track record of building pipelines for passive candidates through creative sourcing, networking, and engagement campaigns.

s.h: THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE
s.t:
Experience at an agency or high-growth startup, with a focus on hard-to-fill roles.
Demonstrated success in market research, talent insights, and competitor intelligence to drive data-driven recruiting decisions.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills to effectively present Rocket Lab’s value proposition to top talent.
Strong time and project management skills, thriving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while managing multiple roles simultaneously.
Creative, resourceful, and highly motivated with a sense of urgency and ownership.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering with hiring managers, directors, and executives to define hiring needs and strategies.
Deep understanding of complex engineering principles and technical job profiles.
This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.
Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab.

Employees may also receive company equity and access to a robust benefits package including: top tier medical HMO, PPO & a 100% company-sponsored medical HSA plan option, dental and vision coverage, 3 weeks paid vacation and 5 days sick leave per year, 11 paid holidays per year, flexible spending and dependent care savings accounts, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and access to a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Other perks include: Discounted employee stock purchase program, subsidized EV charging stations, onsite gym, food and drinks, and other discounts.

About A1 There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior.

Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time. About the Role You will lead hiring across software engineering functions including backend, mobile, desktop, infrastructure, and product engineering.

You will partner closely with founding teams, leadership and engineering leaders to identify and attract high-caliber talent globally. This role requires strong judgment, speed, sourcing ability, and deep understanding of engineering talent quality beyond resumes and brand names. What You'll Be Doing
Lead end-to-end hiring for applications engineering roles globally
Source and engage high-quality software engineering talent across multiple markets
Partner closely with hiring managers and founders on hiring strategy and talent calibration
Assess candidate quality through career progression, technical depth, and execution signals
Drive interview coordination, candidate management, and closing processes
Improve recruiting processes, candidate experience, and hiring quality
Build strong pipelines for backend, mobile, desktop, and product engineering talent
What You'll Need
Proven experience recruiting software engineering talent in technology companies
Strong sourcing and talent mapping capability across global markets
Good understanding of engineering roles, technical stacks, and organizational structures
Ability to identify high-quality talent beyond pedigree and company brands
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and candidate engagement ability
Comfortable operating in fast-moving and ambiguous environments
High ownership and strong execution ability
How We Work The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, fast execution speed, and strong ownership. We care deeply about product quality, clear thinking, and practical execution. This is a hands-on environment.

Everyone is expected to contribute directly, operate independently, and make good decisions under ambiguity. Interview Process If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews. Applications are reviewed by members of our hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process. Originally posted on Himalayas

Recruiting Coordinator NavSav Insurance is seeking a highly organized and motivated Recruiting Coordinator to support our recruiting team and help deliver an efficient, professional candidate experience.

This position will assist with interview scheduling, candidate sourcing, recruiting administration, and the initial steps of the onboarding process. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

This individual will work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, candidates, and HR to keep the hiring process organized and moving forward. Key Responsibilities:
Coordinate and schedule phone screens, interviews, and follow-up meetings between candidates and hiring teams.
Communicate with candidates throughout the interview process and provide timely updates.
Source potential candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, the applicant tracking system, and other recruiting platforms.
Review resumes and identify candidates who meet basic position requirements.
Post and maintain job openings across recruiting platforms and company career pages.
Assist recruiters with candidate outreach and pipeline development.

Collect required information and documentation from candidates following offer acceptance.
Initiate the onboarding process and coordinate the transition of new hires to the HR and onboarding teams.

Help ensure a consistent, organized, and positive candidate experience throughout the recruiting process.

Previous experience in recruiting coordination, human resources, administrative support, or a similar role.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
Professional and responsive when communicating with candidates and company leadership.

Are you a "Cloud-fluent" recruiter who knows that the best talent isn't found on a job board, but through a deep, global network? CloudSmiths is looking for a high-impact Senior Technical Recruiter to join our team.

You’ll be the bridge between our technical delivery teams and a global pool of elite talent, focusing on the GCP, Databricks, and Microsoft Azure ecosystems. This is a full-time, permanent role for someone who thrives on agility and the "grit" of finding the perfect match. The Mission
Manage the full recruitment lifecycle; from initial briefing and headhunting to negotiation and onboarding.
Build a robust pipeline of technical experts across South Africa, the UK, Mauritius, and beyond.
Rapidly source and deploy contractors for project-based team augmentation.
Act as a strategic advisor to hiring managers, defining job specs and providing market-realistic salary benchmarks.

5+ years in technical recruitment, ideally with a blend of agency speed and in-house culture.
You must "speak Cloud." We need someone who understands the nuances of Data Engineers, Cloud Architects, DevOps, and Platform Engineers.
A deep understanding of the South African market and global regions, including compliance, notice periods, and salary expectations.
You have an existing, active network of technical professionals and contractors ready to go.
Technical tertiary qualifications are critical to understanding our technical competencies.
Your DNA
You stay productive in shifting priorities and can handle the "no's" to get to the "yes"
You use data and market insights to challenge hiring managers and "sell" our vision to passive talent.
You follow through on promises and maintain total transparency.
The ability to recognise, respect, and adapt to cultural nuances in communication and negotiation styles.
What’s In It For You?
We reward the "grit" and tenacity it takes to find the right person with a competitive incentive structure
You won't work in a vacuum; you’ll be an engaged collaborator working alongside an existing team of Delivery Capability Leads and Executive Heads
Enjoy your special day with your birthday off and a work culture that prizes agility and professional integrity.
Take responsibility for a global talent pool, giving you exposure to international hiring nuances and compliance.
Ready to power our technical projects with the world's best talent? Apply now! Originally posted on Himalayas

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ElevenLabs is building one of the world's fastest-growing AI companies - and we're looking for a GTM Recruiter to partner with our Revenue org. You'll run full-cycle recruiting across our high volumes roles, partnering with leaders across our Sales Development, Corporate, Mid-Market, and Partnerships team to hire world class talent.
This isn't a conventional recruiting role. You'll work alongside GTM leaders to shape role strategy, design world class candidate experiences, and close exceptional talent across North America. You know what great looks like in a Revenue org - whether from building GTM teams at exceptional tech companies or from your own experience exceeding hiring goals. This role is centered around high ownership, making data driven decisions, and building hiring processes and pipelines that scale.

s.h: What your day might look like
s.t:
Full-cycle recruiting for a broad range of GTM roles including Sales Development Representatives, Account Executives, and Revenue Partnerships.
Partnering closely with GTM leadership to refine role requirements, set hiring strategy, and identify key success signals that elevate quality of hire.
Designing and managing candidate pipelines with a focus on efficiency, transparency, and a white glove, high touch experience.
Acting as a trusted advisor to hiring teams, providing market insights, role benchmarks, and data-driven recommendations.
Representing ElevenLabs externally - every interaction with candidates is an opportunity to bring our brand and values to life.

Full-cycle GTM recruiting experience for a high growth startup, with a strong track record closing quota-carrying roles across Sales roles.
Able to manage high volume and complex searches across multiple priorities without sacrificing quality or urgency.
Strong partner to hiring leaders - you influence with clarity, data, and operational rigor.
Exceptional communicator - you craft compelling role narratives and deliver a high-touch experience for candidates and stakeholders alike.

s.h: BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
s.t:
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you.

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.
This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

That's where you come in.

Review of candidates who have applied via the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
Evaluate candidate qualifications against position requirements and determine who to move forward in the recruitment process.
Develop and manage recruitment marketing plans or sourcing plans to determine the most appropriate candidate sources that align to the search requirements.
Source candidates via resume databases, search engine and networking sites using Boolean search language.
Solicit and pursue referrals from business networks and/or internal referrals.
Utilize Cielo ’s proprietary software for mobile and email campaigning to talent communities.

Articulate value proposition to candidates who are interested in the job opportunity.

Use independent judgement to compare candidate phone interview notes and skills assessments with position requirements to determine if the candidate is a match for the role or a potential match for other open positions.
Issue skills testing as needed and evaluate results (if process dictates).
Review background and reference information (if process dictates).
Influencing the Hire: - Keep candidates engaged throughout process, ensuring consistent communication on the status of the search.

Articulate a job offer to candidate and drive for candidate acceptance, anticipating and negotiating counter-offers as appropriate.
Service Excellence: - Strict adherence to all regulations (OFCCP and all other compliance standards set forth).
Work to deliver a strong candidate slate, continuously building talent pipelines to ensure there are multiple qualified candidates in play at all times.
Provide accurate and regular reporting of recruiting activities to the hiring leader and Cielo leadership to depict both metrics and efforts.
Identify perceived difficulties with searches and research and recommend solutions to both internal and external stakeholders.
Proactively and regularly communicate the status of each search to the hiring leader, providing a consultative approach with recommendations on how to move forward.

Proficient in Boolean search techniques for sourcing.
Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Knowledge of common Human Resources principles, practices and metrics related to talent acquisition.

About Care Access

Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care. We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.
With programs like Future of Medicine , which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and Difference Makers , which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress.

Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.
To learn more about Care Access , visit .

How This Role Makes a Difference
As a Patient Recruiter at Care Access , your mission is to connect patients with cutting-edge clinical trials. You will leverage your excellent communication skills, medical research knowledge, and technology proficiency to identify eligible candidates, educate them about the research, and facilitate their participation. Your commitment to outstanding patient care and your ability to adapt to evolving research protocols will drive the success of our clinical trials.

How You'll Make An Impact

Patient Recruitment: Act as the frontline connection between Care Access and potential study participants. This involves reaching out to individuals from our database and responding to inquiries from potential volunteers through various communication channels such as phone, email, or postal mail.

Patient Education: Educate prospective patients about the clinical research process, including the purpose of the study, potential benefits, and what to expect during study visits. Your ability to explain complex information in an accessible manner is essential.

Documentation: Maintain meticulous records of all patient interactions and communications. Accurate and comprehensive documentation is crucial to ensure a smooth patient journey through the clinical trial process.

Remote Pre-Screening: Conduct remote screening visits for specific studies. This involves using pre-screen checklist and assessing patient compatibility with study criteria and ensuring that all necessary assessments are completed accurately.

Appointment Scheduling: Schedule study visits with qualified subjects, considering their availability and study requirements. Timely reminders and follow-ups are essential to ensure patient commitment.

Collaborate closely with the Study Team and Clinical Research Coordinators (CRCs), serving as a bridge between patients and the research teams. Effective communication and coordination are critical for study success.
Utilize multiple platforms and software tools for managing patient data and scheduling. Proficiency in clinical trials databases, and standard office software is essential.
Review and comprehend active study protocols thoroughly. This understanding allows you to accurately convey study details to potential participants.
Maintain organized subject pre-screening logs to track patient progress, study enrollment, and compliance with study criteria.
Serve as a liaison between patients and both remote and local Clinical Research Coordinators (CRCs). Effective communication and coordination ensure a seamless patient experience.

The Expertise Required

Clinical Research Knowledge: You possess knowledge and the ability to apply ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and other applicable regulatory standards. Your understanding of the clinical research process is essential for ensuring the integrity of our studies.
Medical and Research Terminology: An excellent working knowledge of medical and research terminology is crucial for effective communication with both patients and research teams. Your ability to convey complex information in an understandable manner is key.
Technology Proficiency: Comfortable working with data and technology, you can navigate various platforms for managing patient data and scheduling. Proficiency with clinical trials databases, and Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) is essential.
Time Management: Exceptional time management skills are part of your toolkit. You can effectively manage competing priorities, ensuring that patients receive timely and accurate information.
Team Collaboration Skills: You thrive in a collaborative environment and are capable of working effectively with other team members to accomplish mutual goals. Your positive and supportive attitude contributes to a cohesive team dynamic.
Communication Skills: Your friendly and outgoing personality, coupled with your strong verbal and written communication skills, allows you to maintain a positive attitude even under pressure. You excel at building rapport with patients and colleagues alike.
Adaptability: You are adaptable and flexible, able to navigate changing priorities and evolving research protocols. Your ability to maintain excellent customer service regardless of circumstances is highly valued.
Self-Motivation: You bring a high level of self-motivation and energy to your work. Your dedication to the mission of Care Access drives your commitment to excellence in patient care and support.
Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

A minimum of 1 year of experience in patient recruitment.
A minimum of 1 year of Clinical Research experience.

Bilingual in Spanish is a plus

## Your Purpose ##
MSC Cruises, the world-s third largest cruise line brand is expanding its Procurement team in the USA. Reporting to the MSC USA Procurement Manager, the Purchasing Agent is responsible for managing transactional procurement requests, including purchase order creation, order tracking, and timely processing of requisitions.

This role monitors delivery status and provides timely updates to stakeholders, while collaborating with the Sourcing, Logistics, Planning and Product teams to ensure the proper execution of the ordering process.

The Purchasing Agent also liaises with shipboard personnel to support efficient ordering and loading operations for U.S.-based vessels and MSC Ocean Cay.
This is a hybrid position requiring employees to work from the Miami office four days per week (Monday through Thursday), with the option to work remotely on Fridays.

* Review requisitions (RDA) received from shipboard personnel prior to purchase order creation.
* Create purchase orders and monitor order status throughout the purchasing lifecycle.
* Report shortages and delays to the Procurement Manager to support corrective action and local sourcing when required.
* Provide ongoing support for contracted and non-contracted purchasing requests.
* Follow up with suppliers on deliveries prior to vessel loadings.
* Reconcile invoices and resolve discrepancies related to goods received and payment issues.
* Resolve supplier issues related to delays and discrepancies in accordance with Procurement procedures.
* Maintain accurate and current information within the Company-s ERP, Procurement e-Platform and Discrepancy Reports.
* Collaborate with Sourcing, Logistics, Planning, Product and shipboard teams to support efficient ordering and loading operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve service levels, reduce order processing costs and lead times, minimize supply chain waste and support cost-reduction initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with applicable U.S. federal laws and MSC policies and procedures.

As a Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner at vCluster Labs, you aren't just filling open requisitions, you are the architect of our first hiring presence Internationally. In this role, you will own recruiting across a broad mix of functions, from go to market to technical roles, partnering directly with leaders across the business rather than specializing in a single discipline. You will have the unique opportunity to shape how vCluster Labs hires Internationally.

s.h: As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, your role will include
s.t:
Full Cycle Generalist Recruiting: Own the end to end hiring process across Engineering, Product, Go to Market, and corporate roles globally. You will guide candidates from the initial talent screen through offer, adapting your approach to the function and level you are hiring for.
European Market Leadership: Serve as our first EMEA based recruiter and the local face of vCluster Labs for candidates across Europe. You will build the hiring practices, market knowledge, and candidate networks that support our growth in the region, while staying closely aligned with the US based People Ops team.
Strategic Sourcing: Proactively source and engage passive talent across technical communities as well as sales, marketing, and operations networks. You will build high quality pipelines so we are not relying solely on inbound applicants for priority roles.
Data Driven Execution: Champion our structured interview process across every function you support. You will ensure scorecards are used consistently to reduce bias and maintain strict data integrity within our ATS, Ashby, to inform hiring decisions.
Candidate Experience: Drive an exceptional experience through transparent, timely communication. You will treat every candidate, technical or go to market, with the same customer centric speed, making sure decisions happen in days, not months.
Partnership: Collaborate with hiring managers across departments to define role requirements and ideal candidate profiles. You will act as a consultant on market trends, compensation benchmarks, and closing strategy, not just an order taker.

s.h: This role could be a fit for you if you bring
s.t:
Experience: You have 5+ years of full cycle recruiting experience within a high growth tech startup, spanning multiple functions rather than a single specialty.
Generalist Range: You move comfortably between hiring for technical roles and go to market roles, and you can quickly get conversant in the language and priorities of each.
Location and Reach: You are based in Germany and ready to be vCluster Labs' first hire on the ground in Europe, working across European and US time zones as needed.
A Builder Mindset: You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoy refining processes to make them more efficient, especially as you stand up new practices for our European hiring.
A Data Centric Approach: You value results over tasks. You use data and analytics to track pipeline health across functions and inform decision making.
High EQ and Active Listening: You are an effective communicator who genuinely listens to understand the perspectives of candidates and hiring managers alike, across very different types of roles.

HR Generalist Background: Experience beyond recruiting, such as HR operations, employee relations, or onboarding, that gives you a broader view of the employee lifecycle.
ATS Proficiency: Experience with Ashby.
Domain Expertise: Experience recruiting for open source technology, developer tools, or companies working on Kubernetes tenant isolation.
Global Reach: A background hiring for distributed, remote first teams spanning multiple countries.
About vCluster Labs
We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.
We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams.

Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.
We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. s.h: BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
s.t:
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you.

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.
This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.
Depending on where you are located, you may have the right to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to opt out of AI-assisted review, to request a manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

As a technical recruiter on our R&D team, you will drive full-cycle recruiting for open software engineering roles. In this fast-paced role, you will manage an active load of requisitions, guiding candidates through the hiring process with clarity, speed, and a commitment to quality.
We are looking for someone who is eager to build a career in technical recruiting, highly collaborative, and motivated to learn. You will have access to structured mentorship, supportive leadership, and real-time feedback to help you refine your skills. The candidates who thrive at Samsara are curious, adaptable, and focused on delivering a great experience for candidates and hiring managers alike.
This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

Own full-cycle recruiting: Manage the hiring process for software engineering roles from intake through offer
Execute with efficiency: Keep candidates moving through the process with clear communication, operational discipline, and consistent follow-through
Source proactively: Build diverse candidate pipelines using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and targeted sourcing strategies
Partner with hiring managers: Run structured intake calls, align on candidate profiles, and maintain transparent communication throughout each search
Deliver an exceptional candidate experience: Represent Samsara with timely updates, clear next steps, and respectful communication at every stage
Use data to improve: Track pipeline metrics to identify bottlenecks and refine your sourcing and screening approach
Apply feedback quickly: Work closely with senior recruiters and managers to continually develop your recruiting skillset
Leverage AI thoughtfully: Use AI-based tools and recruiting technology to streamline repetitive tasks while maintaining a high-touch candidate experience

2-5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience (agency or in-house), with software engineering recruiting experience preferred
Proven ability to manage multiple open requisitions in a fast-paced environment
Strong communication skills with candidates and internal team members
Demonstrated growth mindset with a desire to seek out and act on constructive feedback
Proficiency with sourcing tools, including LinkedIn Recruiter and modern applicant tracking systems
Passion for building a long-term career in technical recruiting
The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders.

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company.

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements.

For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements.

Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law.

We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Sie führt ein Team von HR Business Partnern und vereint strategische HR-Beratung, Organisationsentwicklung sowie operative HR-Führung. Darüber hinaus treibt sie die Integration von Akquisitionen, organisatorische Veränderungen und People-Initiativen im Einklang mit der unternehmensweiten HR-Strategie voran.
**Zu den Hauptaufgaben gehören:**
1. **Strategisches HR Business Partnering**
* Hauptansprechpartner für das regionale Management und Beratung der Führungskräfte in Organisationsentwicklung, Leadership und Change Management.
* Leitet aus Geschäftsstrategien HR-Initiativen ab und treibt deren Umsetzung zur Förderung von Wachstum, Performance und Integration voran.

1. **Organisationsentwicklung & Integration**
* Verantwortet die HR-Integration neuer Unternehmen sowie die Umsetzung von Organisations- und Veränderungsinitiativen.
* Unterstützt Führungskräfte in den Bereichen Organisationsdesign, Talent- und Performance-Management sowie Mitarbeiterbindung.
* Fördert Talent- und Nachfolgeplanung auf regionaler Ebene.
1. **Weiterentwicklung des HR-Betriebsmodells**
* Treibt die Umsetzung des HR-Betriebsmodells voran und stärkt die Zusammenarbeit zwischen HR Business Partnern, Shared Services und dem Business.
* Entwickelt das HRBP-Team zu einem strategischen Business-Partnering-Modell weiter.
1. **Führung des HR-Teams**
* Führt, coacht und entwickelt das regionale Team der HR Business Partner.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

As a SpaceX recruiter, you will run a full desk with a variety of duties and responsibilities focused on the sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding of top talent candidates to fill mission critical positions (pun intended).

In many cases, you are candidates’ first encounter with SpaceX and it is your job to represent the company with professionalism, pride, and enthusiasm. We work in teams and focus on collaboration yet require a high degree of autonomy.

So while you are not expected to simply go it alone, you are expected to show initiative, take responsibility, and run with tasks to completion.
Your day-to-day routine will change often as hiring priorities shift, but there is a basic set of activities you can expect to run with daily, including, but not limited to:
Meet with your client groups to discuss headcount, new requisitions, hiring strategy, and/or interview feedback – you truly act as a partner to your clients and not merely as an order taker
Screen candidates who apply to requisitions – as the SpaceX name brand grows, our job postings continue to fill up with stellar candidates
Source candidates – often the best candidates are the ones not actively looking
Discuss candidates you have screened with your client groups and recommend top candidates for interviews
Give tours to candidates before their onsite interview – this is a chance to showcase all the exciting things going on at SpaceX
Attend interviews alongside your client groups to act as another set of eyes and ears in evaluating candidates
Once candidates are approved for hire, you will begin the HR onboarding process including initiating background checks, completing reference checks, negotiating offer packages including extending offer letters, and issuing new hire paperwork – you’ll have plenty of support from the HR, benefits, and compensation departments to make this process as seamless as possible
Some days you will have multiple candidates coming onsite for interviews and you will spend that time giving tours and coordinating the candidate experience. Other days, you will need to fill your candidate pipeline and will spend the majority of the day screening/sourcing candidates. No day is the same here and the pace moves fast, but ultimately your job is to effectively attract, organize, and manage the flow of the country’s most talented individuals to help advance the mission to Mars!

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

Our Global Sourcing team is looking for an exceptional Sourcer to help build the future of global finance at Payward. This is a high-bar role requiring extreme ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate complex hiring challenges in a fully remote, high-agency, async-first environment where speed and quality are the standard.
Main differentiators between this role and any other Sourcer role on the market:
Managing uncertainty : Payward is at the forefront of the innovation spectrum. As such, you can expect to tackle roles that you have never heard about, with no prior experience, data or track record
Subject matter expertise: We are building one interoperable stack connecting crypto, tokenized assets, and traditional markets. We are looking for experts in the fintech field, or deep thinkers able to bridge that gap quickly
Pace: You will be expected to flex your sourcing skills across Tech, Non-tech and anything in between with a very quick turnaround, across different payzones and businesses under the Payward umbrella, including Kraken, Ninjatrader and Reap.
Builder mentality : We are not looking for a plain executioner but someone that will contribute to building something new, awesome and cutting edge
Team work : Our sourcing team’s track record is unprecedented - we provide velocity and quality to our pipelines through hard work, but always working as a team. We have no room for solo players or internal competition
In return, we offer the chance to leave a mark in one of the most innovative companies in the space as well as the opportunity to join a world-class and high-performance team. If you believe you have what it takes, continue reading below.
The opportunity
Partner with Hiring Managers and Recruiters to design and execute effective hiring strategies
Gather, organise and communicate competitive market intelligence, identifying where target talent exists and sharing industry trends
Collaborate with the broader sourcing team in leveraging best practices across research techniques, boolean searches, tools, networking and other sourcing methods
Independently develop and maintain candidate flow across a variety of disciplines, leveraging data to drive decision making and process improvement
Source candidates through a variety of search resources (social media, internal database, job boards, networking, internet searches, etc.)
Be an ambassador to Kraken/Payward, sharing our values and drive brand awareness in the market
Participate in research projects and other initiatives which improve the infrastructure of hiring

Exceptional track record sourcing talent for reputable, fast-growing, high bar technology/product businesses against ruthless competition. Bonus points if you’ve hacked it in crypto, fintech or any product-driven org
High craft - Ability to translate hiring needs into accurate sourcing strategies; strong expertise in boolean/X-ray sourcing
High motor
Scrappiness - you do not see problems but opportunities
Strong product sense
Sound appreciation for the fundamentals of talent acquisition, but creative and inquisitive when considering modern tactics
High agency, strong bias for action, and the confidence to push boundaries, influence stakeholders, and close exceptional talent without compromise.
Comfort in the chaos, thriving in ambiguity, owning your outcomes, and moving with urgency in a fully async, remote-native setting
Ability to produce compelling market intelligence based on business and industry knowledge - Fintech/crypto understanding required.

TL;DR: We’re looking for an AI Research Recruiter who knows where exceptional AI Researchers and engineers can be found. You’ll own full-cycle hiring across research, machine learning, data, evaluations, and ML infrastructure, helping us build one of the strongest teams in AI safety.

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.
We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others
We process over one hundred million API calls every month
We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model
We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.

Follow developments in AI safety, model behavior, evaluations, multimodal systems, agentic systems, data quality, post-training, and ML infrastructure
Design structured hiring processes that assess research depth, engineering ability, originality, and real-world impact
