The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. Banyan is Great Place to Work Certified, a five-time Inc. 5000 honoree, and a top 10 company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Atlanta, Banyan operates more than 100 portfolio companies across North America, the UK, EU, and APAC.
Principal Recruiter: Europe (Hybrid)
We’re building a portfolio of exceptional software businesses across the globe. As our European presence continues to expand through acquisitions and organic growth, we’re looking for a seasoned Principal Recruiter to independently lead and execute hiring across all levels, including executive search, across our portfolio companies and headquarters throughout Europe.
This is a highly visible, high-impact role where you’ll operate as a strategic talent partner to CEOs, senior executives, and business leaders. You’ll own searches end-to-end: scoping roles, mapping markets, engaging candidates, and closing hires without needing day-to-day guidance. Beyond individual searches, you’ll help shape how we approach talent across a growing, multi-country portfolio, bringing structure, best practices, and market intelligence that raises the bar for the entire function.
If you thrive on working autonomously, building trusted relationships with senior leaders, and solving complex hiring challenges across geographies, this is an opportunity to influence growth at both a regional and global level.

Own and execute recruitment across all levels independently. Lead full-cycle hiring from intake through close, including executive-level searches (C-suite, VP, Managing Director, and other key leadership positions) across our growing European portfolio. You’ll manage your own requisition load, prioritize competing demands, and drive results with minimal oversight.
Build proactive, long-term talent pipelines. Continuously map talent landscapes across multiple European markets, identify emerging leaders, and cultivate relationships with high-caliber professionals well before hiring needs arise.
Serve as a trusted talent advisor to senior leaders. Partner directly with CEOs, executives, and leadership teams on talent market trends, organizational design, succession planning, and leadership hiring strategy. You’ll bring a point of view grounded in data and market intelligence, not just fill open roles.
Bring structure and rigor to how we hire. Design and implement best-in-class recruiting processes that can be leveraged across portfolio companies, ensuring a consistent, high-quality hiring experience regardless of geography or business unit.
Leverage data and competitive intelligence. Use market knowledge, compensation benchmarking, and talent analytics to inform hiring decisions and executive search strategies across diverse European geographies.
Connect talent strategy to business outcomes. Work at the intersection of talent and business strategy, helping portfolio companies secure the leaders and key contributors they need to execute growth plans, drive transformation, and maximize long-term value creation.
Elevate the broader recruiting function. Share expertise, mentor less experienced team members, and contribute to the development of scalable recruiting playbooks, tools, and standards across the organization.

Extensive recruiting experience, with deep expertise in executive search, leadership hiring, and senior-level talent acquisition. You’ve led complex, high-stakes searches and closed senior hires in competitive markets.
Proven ability to manage a complex full requisition load independently.
Experience recruiting across multiple European markets with an understanding of diverse talent landscapes, cultures, labor regulations, and hiring environments.
A track record of building and maintaining proactive executive talent pipelines in fast-paced, high-growth, or multi-business environments.
Strong business acumen. You connect talent strategy to organizational growth objectives and can speak the language of the business leaders you support.
Credibility with senior stakeholders. You’ve earned the trust of executives, CEOs, and board-level leaders through data, market intelligence, and strategic insight, not just speed of delivery.
A strategic mindset paired with hands-on execution. You’re equally comfortable advising on org design as you are sourcing a niche candidate in a new market.
In-house executive recruiting experience preferred. Agency or search firm backgrounds are valued, but you should understand the dynamics of partnering with internal stakeholders over time and building long-term relationships inside a growing organization.

Personalberater – Recruiting & Kundenbetreuung (m/w/d)
Du willst Unternehmen wirklich beraten statt nur Profile weiterzureichen – und dabei sehen, was dein Einsatz am Monatsende wert ist? Dann passt das hier.
Beratung und Umsetzung laufen in unserer Branche meist getrennt: Die einen verkaufen, die anderen besetzen, und keiner trägt das Ergebnis ganz. Wir machen es anders. In dieser Position begleitest du deine Kunden von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zur besetzten Stelle. Du weißt genau, was du versprochen hast – weil du es anschließend selbst einlöst.
Hinter dem Ganzen steht Aramaz Digital, eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung mit Sitz in der Bielefelder Innenstadt. Wir machen Unternehmen als Arbeitgeber sichtbar und liefern ihnen kalkulierbar passende Bewerbungen – auf Basis von Daten, nicht von Bauchgefühl. Fachkräftemangel und demografischer Wandel sorgen dafür, dass unser Markt Jahr für Jahr größer wird.
Dein Aufgabengebiet
Kundenbetreuung und Neugeschäft
Du sprichst Unternehmen aktiv an – am Telefon und über Direktkontakte – und weckst Interesse an unseren digitalen Recruiting-Lösungen.
Im Gespräch findest du heraus, woran die Personalgewinnung tatsächlich hakt, und leitest daraus einen konkreten Vorschlag ab.
Du stellst dein Konzept überzeugend vor, verhandelst und bringst den Auftrag zum Abschluss.
Nach dem Start bleibst du fester Ansprechpartner deiner Kunden und baust die Zusammenarbeit weiter aus.
Recruiting und Projektsteuerung
Du planst die Kampagne, steuerst ihre Laufzeit und passt sie an, wenn die Zahlen es verlangen.
Du sichtest Bewerbungen, führst erste Gespräche zur Vorauswahl und sorgst dafür, dass Kandidaten den Prozess positiv erleben.
Bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung behältst du das Projekt in der Hand.
Organisation im Hintergrund
Du hältst deine Aktivitäten im CRM nach, kennst den Stand deiner Pipeline und arbeitest auf klar messbare Ziele hin.
Mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung stimmst du dich eng ab und bringst Ideen ein, wie wir unsere Abläufe schärfen können.
Das erwarten wir von dir
Freude an Akquise: Die aktive Kundenansprache ist für dich kein notwendiges Übel, sondern der Teil, der dich reizt.
Beraterisches Denken: Du stellst die Fragen, die den Kern treffen, erkennst Zusammenhänge und erklärst deine Lösung nachvollziehbar.
Blick für beide Seiten: Du verstehst, was Personalverantwortliche umtreibt – und was Bewerber überzeugt.
Eigener Antrieb: Du strukturierst deinen Tag selbst, steckst Absagen weg und willst mehr erreichen als das Nötigste.
Dein Werdegang ist zweitrangig: Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg aus dem Verkauf – entscheidend ist, was du willst, nicht was auf dem Papier steht. Erfahrung im Recruiting nehmen wir gerne mit, voraussetzen tun wir sie nicht.
Das bekommst du dafür
Vergütung nach oben offen: Festgehalt als sichere Basis, dazu eine Provision ohne Deckelung.
Unbefristet ab dem ersten Tag: Wir planen langfristig mit dir, in einem Markt, der stabil wächst.
Zwei Kompetenzfelder gleichzeitig: Beratung und Personalgewinnung – eine Kombination, die dir jede Tür offen hält. Der Entwicklungsweg ist klar: Recruiter, Junior Consultant, Senior Consultant.
Begleitete Einarbeitung: Strukturiertes Onboarding, Trainings zu Akquise, Beratung und Besetzung, dazu regelmäßige Feedbackrunden.
Arbeitsplatz auf hohem Niveau: Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman-Miller-Stühle, Apple-Hardware – zentral gelegen in Bielefeld.
Fitness auf uns: Premium-Mitgliedschaft im Studio deiner Wahl.
Gut versorgt im Büro: Siebträgermaschine mit Julius-Meinl-Kaffee, ausgesuchte Tees, flexibles Mittagsangebot über Meyer Menü.
Flache Hierarchie: Leistungsorientiert und trotzdem kollegial, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.
Der Bewerbungsweg
Ohne Anschreiben bewerben – der Lebenslauf genügt, zwei Minuten reichen.
Telefonat zum Kennenlernen – Rückmeldung von uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden.
Gespräch vor Ort in unserem Büro in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Wenn du deinen nächsten Schritt selbst bestimmen willst: Wir freuen uns auf dich.

As (Senior) Talent Acquisition Specialist you will be responsible for attracting and hiring talents across Europe, with main focus on DACH region while supporting selected global recruitment projects. You will own the full recruitment lifecycle, partnering closely with hiring managers and business leaders, as well HR Business Partners to understand business needs, develop effective hiring strategies, and deliver best candidate experience.

* **End-to-End Recruitment:**
Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for positions across Europe, with focus on DACH region, while supporting selected global recruitment projects.
Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, define recruitment strategies, and ensure timely, high-quality hiring outcomes.
Lead intake meetings, develop sourcing strategies, conduct interviews, coordinate interview processes, manage offers, and support onboarding activities.
Ensure a positive and professional candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* **Talent Sourcing & Attraction**
Proactively identify, engage, and attract high-quality talent through direct sourcing, LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Develop innovative sourcing strategies for difficult-to-fill positions.
* **Stakeholder Management**
Act as a trusted recruitment partner to hiring managers and HR Business Partners.
Facilitate hiring decisions by ensuring a structured and objective assessment process.
* **Recruitment Administration & Reporting**
Manage recruitment activities within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
Ensure recruitment documentation is accurate and compliant with company policies and local labor legislation.
Track recruitment KPIs and provide regular reporting on hiring activities and recruitment performance.
You will support and contribute to another HR projects as well!

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment, preferably within an international and matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end recruitment, including sourcing strategies, competency-based interviewing, candidate assessment, and selection methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of modern recruitment tools, sourcing techniques, and applicant tracking systems (ATS), with the ability to leverage recruitment data and metrics to drive continuous improvement and informed decision-making.
* Proven experience partnering with business leaders and hiring managers, providing strategic talent acquisition guidance in a complex, multinational environment.
* Experience in developing and executing employer branding initiatives and talent attraction strategies across multiple channels.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple recruitment projects simultaneously while maintaining a high level of quality and candidate experience.
* Fluent in both German and English; additional language skills are considered an asset.

This is a fixed-term contract role supporting Prosci 's Talent Acquisition function across the US and Canada. The Sr. Contract Recruiter owns full life cycle recruiting for an assigned slate of open requisitions, from intake through offer, partnering closely with hiring managers and HR Business Partners to build strong candidate pipelines and a consistently positive candidate experience.
This role is intended to add recruiting capacity for a period of approximately 6 months (September 2026 – February 2027) with an anticipated workload of 20–40 hours per week; volume will vary with interview activity and open requisition load.
Since our founding in 1994, Prosci has been laser-focused on change. By combining our deep understanding of people with a proven methodology rooted in the creation of the ADKAR® model, we’ve helped countless people and organizations thrive. Our solutions empower customers with lasting change resiliency through a unique blend of training, advisory services, and licensing options, including Kaiya, our AI change management coach.
At Prosci , we are a purpose-driven organization full of passionate, curious, and results-oriented people. Working at Prosci means being part of a dynamic team that is dedicated to our purpose of creating a world where change is done right. Join us and be part of a culture that thrives on continuous learning, growth, and making a difference.
Check out our website for more about our team and approach: .

Recruiting
Manage full life cycle recruiting for assigned US and Canadian requisitions: intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, assessment administration, reference and background checks, and offer support.
Lead intake and needs analysis conversations with hiring managers to confirm role scope, must-have criteria, and hiring timeline before opening a requisition.
Partner with HRBPs to create and publish job descriptions and postings.
Source active and passive candidates using Prosci 's ATS (Workable), LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, employee referrals, and other channels.
Conduct phone screens, coordinate interview loops, administer assessments, and lead scorecard completion and debrief discussions with interview teams.
Maintain regular, high-quality communication with candidates throughout the process to protect the candidate’s experience.
Support offer construction and, in partnership with the hiring HRBP and hiring manager, help negotiate terms with candidates.
Pipeline, Compliance, and Candidate Experience
Build and maintain candidate pipelines for roles that recur or are historically difficult to fill.
Apply sourcing, screening, and interview practices consistent with Prosci 's commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, including attention to underexplored talent pools.
Apply working knowledge of US and Canadian hiring requirements relevant to recruiting (for example, pay transparency rules, background check requirements, and state or provincial variation) and flag questions to HR Business Partners rather than making independent compliance calls.
Perform select preboarding activities for new hires from the point of offer acceptance to start date, including internal stakeholder communication, coordination of first day logistics, and scheduling of week 1 core onboarding sessions.
Reporting and Process
Keep candidate and requisition records current and accurate in the ATS (Workable).
Provide regular pipeline and hiring status updates to hiring managers and HR Business Partners.
Flag process friction or candidate experience issues to HR Business Partners and suggest improvements.

Full life cycle recruiting experience across sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer support, ideally spanning both US and Canadian hiring. Working knowledge of US and Canadian employment and hiring practices, with good judgment about when to escalate a compliance question (only US is required).
Working proficiency with an applicant tracking system and with LinkedIn Recruiter or an equivalent sourcing tool.
Strong written and verbal communication, comfortable managing multiple candidates, requisitions, and hiring manager relationships at once.
Ability to work independently against a defined requisition load with minimal day-to-day oversight.
Comfort using AI tools across the recruiting life cycle, primarily to synthesize interview notes and scorecard feedback into clear, evidence-based debrief summaries and candidate recommendations, with sound judgment about reviewing AI output for accuracy and bias before it informs a hiring decision.

5+ years of in-house or agency recruiting experience.
Demonstrated experience recruiting across a range of levels, from individual contributor through professional or exempt roles.
Experience recruiting for professional services, consulting, or other high-growth organization is a plus.
Prior contract or interim recruiting experience, comfortable ramping quickly on a new team's process and requisitions.
Experience with Predictive Index or a similar behavioral assessment tool.
Familiarity with competency-based, inclusive interviewing practices.
Additional Information
Work Location: Remote within the US or Canada.

At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.
Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.
Our Talent team is looking for an experienced and discerning technical recruiter to help build Linear’s next generation of engineering talent. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who sees recruiting as a craft.
Your primary focus will be growing our engineering team in North America. You’ll work closely with engineering leadership and our existing recruiters across product, infrastructure, AI, mobile, and emerging technical roles. You’ll own the full search, from mapping talent markets and activating networks through assessment, work trial support, and close.
Linear engineers tend to combine technical depth with product judgment, craftsmanship, and significant ownership. Finding them requires more than matching resumes to requirements.

We’re looking for someone who can recognize these qualities, reach candidates with precision, and continually sharpen their judgment through close partnership with our team. All recruiters at Linear are generalists and may support other functions as company priorities evolve, but engineering will be the primary focus of this role.
Location & work mode
Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North American (Eastern time zone), with a strong preference for the New York City area.

Being in New York enables closer partnership with our growing local team, candidate events, and optional in-person support during work trials. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

Maintain accurate, useful data in Ashby and ensure hiring partners have clear visibility into pipeline health, risks, and next steps
Contribute to how our small Talent team works, while remaining adaptable enough to support other functions as company needs evolve

Vous êtesconvaincu·eque les RH sont un levier clé de performance et d'engagement ? Vous aimez être au cœur des équipes, accompagner les managers au quotidien et transformer les enjeux opérationnels en solutions RH concrètes ?
Rejoignez TMR - Transports Martigny Régionen tant quePartenaire RH du Département Exploitation.
**Partenaire Ressources Humaines (H/F)**
**Le contexte : une fonction RH enpleine construction**
TMR traverse une phase de structuration et de modernisation de safonction RH. Les fondations de la politique RH sont posées ; il reste désormais à bâtir et industrialiser l'essentiel des processus qui structureront durablement la fonction pour nos quelque 240 collaborateurs.
Concrètement, plusieurs chantiers avancent en parallèle : déploiement d'un nouveau SIRH et de ses workflows (recrutement, entrée, sortie, signature électronique), construction d'une architecture des emplois, digitalisation du cycle de vie collaborateur, pilotage prévisionnel de la masse salariale et gestion prévisionnelle des effectifs et des compétences (GPEC).

C'est un moment rare où presque tout est à concevoir, à outiller et à ancrer dans les usages - et où votre contribution aura un impact direct, concret et visible.
Dans cecontexte, nous recherchons un·e Partenaire RH qui aime autant accompagner les équipes au quotidien que construire les processus et les outils qui feront la maturité de demain. Vous rejoindrez une équipe RH resserrée, agile et ambitieuse, à un moment charnière de sa transformation, avec une réelle latitude pour proposer, structurer et faire.
**Votre rôle**
Rattaché·e au Responsable des Ressources Humaines, vous êtes le point de contact privilégié des managers et des collaborateurs sur un périmètre d'environ 100 collaborateurs, au cœur du Département Exploitation. Vous intervenez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des collaborateurs, contribuez au déploiement de la politique RH et agissez comme un·e partenaire de confiance : opérationnel·le, conseiller·ère et facilitateur·rice.
**Ce que vous ferez au quotidien**
* Piloter les recrutements de A à Z sur votre périmètre et assurer une intégration fluide et engageante des nouveaux collaborateurs
* Conseiller les managers sur les profils et les décisions de recrutement
* Participer au pilotage proactif de la masse salariale, en réalisant une gestion prévisionnelle des effectifs et des compétences avec les managers
* Contribuer à faire vivre la culture d'entreprise
* Accompagner le cycle de vie des collaborateurs
* Soutenir les managers dans les moments clés : mobilité, évolution, performance, situations sensibles, départs
* Conduireou co-animer les entretiens RH stratégiques
* Garantir un suiviadministratiffiable et qualitatif
* Être un·e véritable partenaire opérationnel·le des managers
* Apporterun regard RH, légal et humain dans la prise de décision
* Conseiller sur les sujets organisationnels et relationnels
* Prévenir et gérer les situations complexes ouconflictuelles
* Gérer les processus RH de votre périmètre avec rigueur et efficacité
* Veiller à la qualité des données RH
* Contribueractivement aux projets RH transverses (nouveaux outilsdigitaux, architecture des emplois, QVT, culture-) et déployer concrètement les politiques RH au sein des équipes
**Une composante paie à part entière**
Ce poste comporte une véritable dimension paie, structurante pour notre organisation. Au-delà de la collaboration étroite avec la paie, nous attendons une autonomie opérationnelle complète sur ce volet :
* **Exécuter une paie de A à Z** **:** vous êtes en mesure d'assurer la relève et le remplacement de la titulaire de la paie de l'entreprise (continuité de service en cas d'absence ou de surcharge), sur l'ensemble du cycle mensuel jusqu'aux déclarations
* **Gérer en propre la paie d'une filiale** d'une dizaine de collaborateurs, de bout en bout et enpleineresponsabilité
* **Maîtriser un logiciel de paie** et savoir en exploiter les fonctionnalités dans un environnement légal suisse (LPP, assurances sociales, retenues, certificats de salaire)
* **Cette double casquette** - partenaire RH de terrain et chargé-e de paie autonome - est au cœur du poste et en fait un rôle à la fois riche et exigeant
**Votre profil**
* Une expérience confirmée de 5 ans dans un environnement exigeant (transports publics ou industrie de préférence)
* Une solide connaissance du droit du travail suisse
* Une expérienceconfirmée sur des missions de partenaire RH au sein de PME
* Une réelleautonomie sur la paie : capacité à exécuter une paie complète de A à Z et maîtrise d'un logiciel de paie (idéalement en contexte suisse)
* Une capacité à gérerplusieurssujetsenparallèle, avec autonomie et discernement
* Une excellentemaîtrise des outilsdigitaux RH et des systèmes SIRH
* Une appétence pour la construction : structurer des processus, outiller et faire vivre les usages dans unefonctionen transformation
* Une formation digitale (type CAS Digital) est souhaitée pour ce poste
* Langue : français langue maternelle. L'anglais opérationnel est un plus apprécié.
**Cequi vous distingue**
* Une véritable posture de « business partner », orientée solutions et proactive
* Une vraiequalité d'écoute et un sens du relationnel développé
* Une grande ouverture d'esprit sur l'innovation RH, les outils digitaux et l'IA au service des RH
* Une capacité à prioriser et à évoluer dans un environnementdynamique
* Une excellente connaissance du tissu économique local
* Nationalité suisse oupermis B/C
**Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**
Chez TMR, nous transportons bien plus que des passagers : nous connectons des personnes et des territoires avec fiabilité, sécurité et proximité. Nous valorisons l'engagement, la collaboration et l'innovation, dans un environnement dynamique où chaque collaborateur contribue à notre mission quotidienne.
Vous évoluerez dans un cadre de travail flexible et convivial, au cœur de la région de Martigny, avec des équipes passionnées et des valeursfortes : proximité, esprit d'équipe et responsabilitésociale. Faire partie de TMR, c'est rejoindre une organisation qui place l'humain au centre de ses choix et qui vous donne les moyens de grandir et d'innover dans votre rôle.
**TMR vous offrira aussi des avantages tels que :**
* Un AG 2ème classe dès la fin de votre période d'essai, pris intégralement à la charge de l'entreprise (valeur fiscale déclarée dans le certificat de salaire)
* La possibilité de télétravailler régulièrement (un à deux jours par semaine selon le taux d'activité)
* Une LPP plus généreuseque le minimum légal, assortie d'un montant de coordination réduit et d'une part employé maintenue à 7,5 % quelque soit l'âge
* Des facilités de voyages à tarif réduit pour vos proches et des déplacements en train à l'international à tarif réduit après un an d'ancienneté
* De petits plus comme le Mont-Blanc Express gratuit jusqu'à Chamonix sur demande, des entrées gratuites à la Fondation Gianadda ou encore des places pour les matchs du FC Sion

Company Description
Wüest Partner is an innovative and independent software and service company in the real estate industry. Since 1985, we have been creating sound decision-making foundations by combining real estate expertise, data, and digital solutions. As an industry leader, we shape the future of the real estate sector together with our clients - offering comprehensive services in valuation, consulting, data, analytics, AI, software, sustainability, and education.
The Wüest Partner Group employs around 500 people at 15 locations across Europe, with its headquarters in Switzerland. The group includes the subsidiaries Durable, Datahouse, Qualicasa, and Signa-Terre.
Job Description
Your Team & Mission
Recruiting is much more to us than just filling open positions - it is a crucial success factor for our growth. As part of our Human Resources Department, you will become a member of our Talent Acquisition & Development team and be responsible for operational recruiting in Switzerland and our international locations. You will work closely with our managers, HR business partners, and HR services, actively shaping recruitment success.
Together, we create a positive employee experience - from attracting new talent to developing our employees. With your experience, entrepreneurial thinking, and advisory skills, you ensure that we attract the right talent even in a dynamic environment.
Due to an upcoming maternity leave in our team, we are now looking for reinforcement and look forward to an experienced individual who will help us further develop Talent Acquisition and contribute to the future expansion of our department.
Your Tasks
* You are responsible for the entire recruiting process (end-to-end) for positions in Switzerland as well as at our international locations.
* You advise and coach hiring managers as a competent sparring partner and support them in making well-founded recruitment decisions, ensuring a smooth recruiting process.
* You develop targeted search strategies together with the specialist departments and implement them independently.
* You actively identify and approach suitable talents via various channels (active sourcing).
* You ensure an excellent candidate experience and professionally accompany candidates throughout the entire application process.
* You collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders and manage to advise and convince in a solution-oriented manner even in challenging situations.
* You analyse recruiting metrics, identify optimisation potentials, and contribute ideas for the continuous development of our recruiting processes and employer branding activities.

Your Profile
* At least five years of experience in in-house talent acquisition as well as experience recruiting for Switzerland and ideally for international locations.
* Completed studies (FH/university) or comparable education and training with a focus on human resources, business administration, or psychology.
* Active sourcing is second nature to you, and you use modern recruiting methods purposefully.
* You bring strong advisory skills and manage to professionally coach or challenge hiring managers and navigate confidently in a diverse stakeholder environment.
* You work independently, prioritise confidently, and take responsibility for your topics.
* You think entrepreneurially, recognise opportunities, and implement pragmatic solutions.
* Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken.
Additional Information

* Attractive employment conditions with a variable compensation component
* Flexible Work Smart concept with home office option
* Refreshing, professional, and collegial corporate culture with great events (company celebrations, croissant breaks, etc.)
* High team spirit, flat hierarchies, and varied tasks
* Beautiful workplace in the centre of Zurich with modern infrastructure
* Generous training budget including time for it as well as other attractive fringe benefits
Contact
If you have any questions, Federica Arcella, Lead Talent Acquisition Coordinator & Development, will be happy to assist you at talentacquisition@wuestpartner.com.

The experience you create will be a direct expression of Roblox's investment in this team. You will report to the People Business Partner Lead supporting the Vancouver engineering organization.

Talent Strategy
Own full-cycle talent acquisition for the Vancouver site. Partner with Engineering leadership to define hiring strategy, recruit for senior and niche technical roles, build local talent pipelines, and support workforce planning as the team scales.
Champion Roblox as an employer of choice in the Vancouver tech market through partnerships with universities,, and local industry networks.
Collaborate with the Early Careers team to make Roblox Vancouver a standout internship destination by overseeing the local intern program end-to-end and building a pipeline of future full-time hires.
Office Health & Employee Experience
Drive the programs and rituals that make Vancouver a high-engagement, high-trust office from onboarding to team events to feedback loops that surface what the team actually needs.
Serve as the trusted go-to for Vancouver employees: fielding questions, navigating sensitive situations, and connecting people to the right resources across People, Legal, Immigration, and Finance.

8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with depth in technical domains (Engineering, Gaming, Rendering/Graphics, AI/ML, etc.)
Demonstrated success hiring senior and niche technical talent in competitive markets
A strong track record of influencing stakeholders and solving complex recruiting challenges with creativity and innovation
A data-driven approach with the ability to analyze metrics, surface insights, and inform strategy
Experience building people programs and systems from the ground up, with outcomes you can speak to
A startup mentality and openness to thinking outside the box
Excitement about being on-site full-time in Vancouver: you believe in-person presence matters and you show up with energy.

Strategically minded: you can zoom out to understand what a site needs to grow well, then zoom in to execute the detailed work that makes it happen.
A connector: you build trust quickly with employees and cross-functional partners at all levels, and you know how to get things done through influence rather than authority.
Data-informed: you use signals, survey results, retention trends, anecdotal feedback to shape priorities and make the case for investment.
Proactive, not reactive: you anticipate what the office and employees need before problems surface, and you move fast when they do.
Invested in people: you care deeply about the experience of every person in the Vancouver office and show up as a genuine advocate for what they need to do their best work.

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

Rocket Lab’s People & Culture team is responsible for looking after our most valuable asset: our people. Across our global teams, the People & Culture team supports our people and departments across recruitment, new staff orientation, compensation, training and development.

They make sure our growing and diverse global team is supported and capable of delivering our projects and customer’s missions, and they’re responsible for supporting their development, nurturing their skills and talent, and retaining the world-class people already on our team.

s.h: TALENT ACQUISITION PARTNER II / SENIOR - CONTRACT
s.t:
Based onsite at Rocket Lab’s Middle River, MD facility, the Talent Acquisition Partner is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with hiring managers and candidates alike to fill highly critical roles.
This is a full life-cycle recruitment position – you will own everything from initial sourcing and screening to extending offers. As a member of the TA team, you will be integral in fulfilling our mission to open up access to space to improve life on earth by hiring innovators who will help shape our rapidly expanding programs.
*This is a 6-month fixed-term role for immediate hire, with the potential opportunity to convert to full-time employment upon term completion. This role sits onsite at our Middle River, MD facility – remote work is not considered for this position.*

Serve as a strategic hiring expert and partner to hiring managers and business unit leaders
Partner with hiring managers to determine the requirements and expectations for their open positions, and the qualities of their ideal candidate
Manage the full hiring life-cycle, from initial sourcing and screening to extending offers
Screen candidates for open roles and guide them through the interview process
Build a diverse pipeline of talent, including passive candidates, through sourcing, cold calling, phone screens, and networking
Utilize our ATS (Greenhouse) to build reports and analyze key metrics on recruiting activities to drive process improvements
Travel as needed to support hiring efforts at other sites, including Launch Complex 3 in Wallops Island VA and Space Structures Complex in Middle River, MD

s.t:
Bachelor’s degree
2+ years of full-time, full-cycle recruiting experience

s.h: YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A SENIOR TA PARTNER I
s.t:

s.h: 8+ years of full-time recruiting experience preferred
s.t:
Agency and in-house recruiting experience
Experience recruiting for high-volume nonexempt roles and/or engineering roles such as: production, manufacturing, test, mechanical, electrical, systems, propulsion, etc.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment supporting high-performing teams
Strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with hiring managers at all levels, as well as candidates and external partners
Previous experience sourcing for highly technical and niche roles
This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.
Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab.

Employees may also receive company equity and access to a robust benefits package including: top tier medical HMO, PPO & a 100% company-sponsored medical HSA plan option, dental and vision coverage, 3 weeks paid vacation and 5 days sick leave per year, 11 paid holidays per year, flexible spending and dependent care savings accounts, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and access to a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Other perks include: discounted employee stock purchase program, and free snacks/drinks onsite.
Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status, please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion.

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace.

We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

s.h: FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY
s.t:
To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here .

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com. This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

s.h: FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY
s.t:
For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.
Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

As part of our Global Emerging Talent Team, you'll help build the pipeline that fuels Datadog's future, owning the full candidate journey for our interns, new grads, and early career hires across EMEA.
We're evolving how we do Emerging Talent recruiting. In 2026 and beyond, this isn't just about filling a calendar of campus events. It's about building a predictable, high-quality pipeline, delivering a candidate experience people talk about, driving representation at the entry level, using data to make sharper decisions, and taking smart risks to keep improving how we do all of it. This role is central to that shift.
At Datadog, we place value in our office culture. The relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace (3 days/week in our Paris office) to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

Own the pipeline and candidate experience
Own the end-to-end candidate lifecycle for assigned schools, functions, or programs across EMEA, from sourcing and screening through offer and conversion,
Deliver a high-touch, consistent candidate experience across every touchpoint: outreach, interviews, events, internship hosting, and offer
Maintain funnel momentum, diagnose issues early, and unblock your pipeline weekly
Be a brand ambassador
Represent Datadog as a premier employer for emerging talent across university campuses and virtual channels in EMEA
Own key university and student organization relationships; act as the face of Datadog on campus
Plan and execute recruiting events, career fairs, hackathons, info sessions, and "beyond campus" engagements that create real excitement, not just check a box
Embed yourself in the culture of the schools and organizations you partner with, and connect that understanding back to our recruiting goals
Drive inclusive, representative hiring
Build inclusive sourcing and engagement strategies and track representation across your funnel
Identify where diverse candidates drop off and take action to improve outcomes at every stage: outreach, interview, and close
Use data to get better, not just to report
Know your personal KPIs (conversion, offer acceptance, funnel health) and use them to self-correct
Use AI-enabled tools to summarize data, spot trends, and reduce manual work, while checking outputs for accuracy before acting on them
Bring insights and recommendations to hiring partners, not just status updates
Innovate and iterate
Test new engagement formats, sourcing strategies, and event formats; measure what works and share it with the team
Adopt a "Start, Stop, Continue" mindset after each recruiting cycle

1-3 years of experience in campus, university, or early career recruiting
Proven ability to build and manage a candidate pipeline end-to-end
Strong communicator who can represent Datadog confidently in front of students, hiring managers, and university partners
Comfortable with data and the ability to track your own numbers and use them to improve your approach
Organized and adaptable; you can run multiple events, timelines, and candidates at once without dropping the ball
Fluent in English and French; additional European languages are a plus
Willingness to travel to campuses across Europe

3-5+ years of experience in campus/early career recruiting, including ownership of complex or high-priority school relationships and programs
Track record of shaping strategy, not just executing a plan. You've influenced hiring partners with data and driven measurable improvements to pipeline or inclusion outcomes
Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders and holding hiring teams accountable to shared goals
History of mentoring or coaching other recruiters and setting the bar for team behaviors
We understand not everyone will meet every qualification on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about early talent and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

s.h: How you will make an impact
s.t:
As a Technical Recruiter in Portugal, you'll be part of a global Talent Acquisition team and an ongoing Lisbon presence. You will hire across technical and non-technical disciplines - sourcing and engaging candidates, guiding them through our hiring process, and owning a candidate experience that reflects who we are as a company.
This role is ideal for someone early in their recruiting career who is genuinely curious about technology and who wants to learn how a high-performing engineering organization is built. You won't just execute a process: you'll be expected to understand the "why" behind every role, raise the bar on how we work, and build real, lasting relationships with the people we hire (and the ones we don't).
One of our core values is a growth mindset, and Iterable is a company where everyone can grow. If this role excites you, please apply, as we value applicants for the skills they bring beyond the job description. Note: Please kindly submit your resume in English. Thank you!

s.h: How you will make a difference
s.t:
Support and progressively own full-cycle recruitment across multiple roles as we grow our Lisbon team
Deliver a top-class candidate experience at every touchpoint - build genuine, lasting relationships, understand what drives each person, and make every interaction reflect who Iterable is
Partner with hiring managers to understand each role deeply - the tech stack, the team, the "why" - and use that knowledge to engage and evaluate candidates more effectively
Bring a technologist mindset to everything you do: actively explore AI tools, test new approaches, and find smarter ways to work across sourcing, outreach, and day-to-day recruiting
Support TA operations - maintaining templates, coordinating scheduling, and keeping our ATS up to date - ensuring the foundations are always in place for a seamless hiring process
Start building your presence in the local tech community - representing Iterable at events, growing your network, and nurturing candidate relationships over time

Real drive and ambition: you want to improve your work, raise standards, and deliver with genuine care
Curious to understand the "why" behind roles, decisions, and processes
An obsession with human connection and candidate experience - you believe recruiting is fundamentally a people job
Strong written and verbal communication skills

Familiarity with ATS platforms (especially Greenhouse), LinkedIn Recruiter, and/or alternative sourcing tools

This role partners directly with C-suite and SVP-level stakeholders to build the leadership teams that will drive MongoDB's next phase of growth. We're looking for someone who brings a blend of executive search agency rigor and in-house recruiting fluency, ideally with experience in the technology industry.
This role will be based out of our New York City office with a hybrid working model.

Own end-to-end executive search processes for VP+ level roles, from intake through offer and close
Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring executives and the leadership team, shaping search strategy, candidate profiles, and market mapping
Build and manage a proactive pipeline of senior leadership talent through direct sourcing, market research, and a strong external network
Conduct in-depth candidate assessments, including competency-based interviews and reference checks, to ensure strong leadership and cultural alignment
Manage complex, multi-stakeholder search processes with discretion, precision, and executive presence
Partner with People teams on compensation strategy, offer construction, and negotiation for senior hires
Represent MongoDB's employer brand and leadership hiring standards in every candidate and stakeholder interaction
Continuously sharpen executive hiring processes, tools, and market intelligence to keep MongoDB competitive for top leadership talent

Significant experience in executive recruiting, ideally with a blend of retained/executive search agency and in-house corporate recruiting experience
A track record of closing senior leadership searches (VP and above) in complex, fast-moving organizations
Deep experience partnering with and influencing senior executives and stakeholders
Strong market knowledge and an active network within the technology industry; experience in adjacent industries will also be considered for the right candidate
Excellent judgment, discretion, and the ability to navigate highly confidential searches
Sharp assessment and interviewing skills, with the ability to evaluate leadership capability, not just resume fit
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the polish to represent MongoDB to external executive audiences
A collaborative, low-ego approach paired with the confidence to push back and advise senior stakeholders

As a Recruiter , you’ll partner with teams across EMEA, Mexico, and Brazil to attract and hire exceptional talent. As a Riot brand ambassador, you’ll deliver an inclusive, thoughtful, and high-quality candidate experience while bringing Riot’s teams, products, and player-focused mission to life. You’ll also contribute to projects and process improvements that strengthen our recruiting practices globally.
Reporting to the Supervisor, Talent Acquisition – EMEA, Mexico & Brazil, you’ll manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from developing sourcing strategies and engaging talent to partnering with hiring teams on their recruitment needs. You’ll build a strong understanding of the teams and talent markets you support, helping shape effective hiring strategies and workforce plans.
This role is based in our Dublin office and operates on a hybrid working model, combining in-office collaboration with remote work.

Manage end to end recruitment process including stakeholder management & interview coordination across all pillars and disciplines.
Build and maintain global talent pipelines , identifying candidates across multiple markets and geographies.
Develop innovative sourcing strategies using advanced Boolean search, targeted campaigns, talent communities, referrals, events, and specialist networks .
Proactively identify and engage passive talent , tailoring outreach to different roles, markets, and candidate profiles.
Partner closely with hiring managers to understand requirements, talent landscapes, and develop effective sourcing strategies.
Build trusted relationships with candidates and stakeholders, delivering a high-quality candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
Track sourcing and recruitment metrics to assess pipeline health, identify gaps, and continuously improve sourcing effectiveness.
Ensure recruitment activity remains efficient, compliant, and consistent across different international markets.
Champion Riot’s employer brand when engaging global technical talent, effectively communicating our opportunities, culture, and player-focused mission.

2+ years of professional recruiting experience within the games industry and/or software development.
Experience managing full-cycle recruitment, including candidate assessment, stakeholder management, onboarding, and international hiring for software engineering and other technical roles.
Strong experience in talent operations, recruitment project management, compliance, and continuous process improvement.

Experience recruiting for or supporting roles within game development.
Understanding of software development disciplines, roles, and talent profiles.
Fluency in an additional language is a plus.
For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and Riot will support your retirement benefits with a company match, and double down on your donations of time and money to non-profit charitable organizations.

s.h: Check out our benefits pages for more information.
s.t:
At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission.

And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The recruiting team seeks to build the culture of Stripe by aligning the strongest global talent to our highest impact business needs. They focus on bringing Stripe’s operating principles to life in their recruiting processes, providing the highest-quality candidate experience, and leveraging data driven storytelling to influence the business.

To further this important mission, we are looking for consultative and creative recruiters to grow and scale our Go-to-Market (GTM) team. The GTM organization at Stripe encompasses our Sales team, Marketing and Sales Development, GTM and Product Operations, and Professional Services.

These teams are expanding in the region, focusing on bringing new users onto the Stripe platform, supporting our existing users' scale, and growing their businesses. You can expect high impact and wide-ranging responsibilities: owning full-cycle recruiting, driving hiring strategy, and delivering best-in-class candidate experience.

This person must be a builder who thrives in a learning environment—unafraid to try new things, embrace new ideas, and welcome suggestions for how we can iterate on our processes. This is an 11 month fixed-term contract.

Partner with senior leaders across the organization to understand their hiring objectives and develop recruiting strategies aimed at achieving headcount goals, with an emphasis on expanding our GTM teams in EMEA.
Propose and implement creative and scalable changes to the existing recruiting strategy to enhance efficacy and reach
Track and analyze recruiting metrics, providing regular reports on hiring progress to business leadership to ensure transparency and alignment with goals
Develop and execute strategic sourcing plans to identify and engage top talent, ensuring a robust and inclusive candidate pool for current and future hiring needs
Conduct regular market research and analysis to stay informed about talent trends in the EMEA region, using insights to inform recruiting strategies and address potential challenges
Work closely with cross-functional teams—including Finance, People Ops, Benefits, Onboarding, and Legal—to deliver a seamless and high-quality candidate experience

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Have fun and enjoy your contribution to growing an exciting company.

The demand for home renovations has never been stronger, yet, it's surprisingly difficult for a new homeowner to renovate. It can take a decade to build up enough home equity and savings to pay for a major renovation. As a result, recent homeowners do a lot of financially-suboptimal things to compensate like borrow from their 401k, rack up credit card debt, and use high-interest personal loans. Or they just live unhappily for years in a home that doesn't meet their family's needs.
But by completing a major renovation, homeowners are increasing the value of their home. Professional real estate investors leverage this After Renovation Value (ARV) to roll the increase in value into new properties all the time. But there hasn't been a great way for homeowners to take advantage of this. If homeowners had an ability to borrow against the ARV, they could increase their borrowing power up to 10x.
To meet this need, RenoFi created a platform that enables homeowners to borrow funds from RenoFi approved lenders in the form of the first home equity loan purpose-built for renovations! Unlike standard home equity loans, RenoFi Loans use the value of your home post-renovation which lets you borrow the most money at the best possible terms. RenoFi is creating a full suite of renovation loan products to better suit the needs of today’s homeowners!
For homeowners, RenoFi makes it possible to renovate years earlier than might be otherwise feasible. For contractors, we empower the financing of renovations at the point of sale, reducing instances of scope reduction, and ensuring prompt payment.

Our lender partners, most often credit unions, rely on RenoFi's platform to generate loans, create efficiencies, and grow membership. The lenders pay RenoFi for the new loans, which allows us to offer our services to homeowners for free. RenoFi is truly a win-win-win for everyone involved.
RenoFi is backed by some of the best startup investors in the world, including First Round Capital, Comcast Ventures, and Canaan Partners.

You’ll also contribute to projects and process improvements that strengthen our recruiting practices globally.
Reporting to the Supervisor, Talent Acquisition – EMEA, Mexico & Brazil, you’ll manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from developing sourcing strategies and engaging talent to partnering with hiring teams on their recruitment needs. You’ll build a strong understanding of the teams and talent markets you support, helping shape effective hiring strategies and workforce plans.
This role is based in our Dublin office and operates on a hybrid working model, combining in-office collaboration with remote work.

Manage end to end recruitment process including stakeholder management & interview coordination across all pillars and disciplines.
Build and maintain global talent pipelines , identifying candidates across multiple markets and geographies.
Develop innovative sourcing strategies using advanced Boolean search, targeted campaigns, talent communities, referrals, events, and specialist networks .
Proactively identify and engage passive talent , tailoring outreach to different roles, markets, and candidate profiles.
Partner closely with hiring managers to understand requirements, talent landscapes, and develop effective sourcing strategies.
Build trusted relationships with candidates and stakeholders, delivering a high-quality candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
Track sourcing and recruitment metrics to assess pipeline health, identify gaps, and continuously improve sourcing effectiveness.
Ensure recruitment activity remains efficient, compliant, and consistent across different international markets.
Champion Riot’s employer brand when engaging global technical talent, effectively communicating our opportunities, culture, and player-focused mission.

2+ years of professional recruiting experience within the games industry and/or software development.
Experience managing full-cycle recruitment, including candidate assessment, stakeholder management, onboarding, and international hiring for software engineering and other technical roles.
Strong experience in talent operations, recruitment project management, compliance, and continuous process improvement.

Experience recruiting for or supporting roles within game development.
Understanding of software development disciplines, roles, and talent profiles.
Fluency in an additional language is a plus.
For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and Riot will support your retirement benefits with a company match, and double down on your donations of time and money to non-profit charitable organizations.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission.

And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!
We are looking for an experienced Technical Recruiter to join our People team. The Technical Recruiter owns full-cycle recruiting across technical functions, including Engineering, Data, Product, and AI/ML. . They source, engage, and close candidates while partnering closely with hiring managers throughout the process.

This role requires a strong understanding of technical roles and the talent market, with the ability to advise hiring managers on candidate profiles, sourcing strategy, timelines, and compensation.

The Technical Recruiter is proactive and hands-on, with a focus on finding and building relationships with great candidates, including those who may not be actively looking.

They will also contribute to Talent Acquisition strategy, process improvements, and a positive candidate experience while building strong relationships with candidates, hiring teams, and senior leaders. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.
This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

Full Lifecycle Recruitment
Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for technical and specialized roles, from intake through closing the finalist candidate and handing them off to the People Team for onboarding.
Recruit across functions including Engineering, Data, Product, and other disciplines.
Develop a strong understanding of each role, the business need behind it, and the capabilities required for someone to be successful.
Develop and execute thoughtful sourcing strategies, with a strong focus on identifying and engaging passive talent.
Build relationships with candidates throughout the process and ensure a thoughtful, responsive, and positive candidate experience.
Serve as a strategic lead throughout the search, partnering with recruiting and People Team colleagues on administrative and coordination needs where appropriate.
Talent Partnership
Bring expertise in technical functions and the external talent market to help leaders calibrate role scope, leveling, candidate profiles, and hiring expectations.
Provide perspective on talent availability, competitive hiring dynamics, compensation, and the feasibility of different hiring strategies.
Challenge assumptions and make recommendations when a role, profile, level, or search strategy may need to change based on the market.
Use your understanding of the talent market and organizational needs to help inform broader workforce planning and organizational design.
Build trusted relationships with hiring leaders and serve as a thought partner throughout the hiring process.
Strategic Sourcing
Take a proactive, research-driven approach to identifying talent, particularly for difficult-to-fill and highly competitive roles.
Map relevant talent markets, companies, teams, and candidate pools to identify where strong candidates are likely to be found.
Develop creative approaches to engaging passive candidates and building relationships with talent before they are actively looking.
Experiment with new sourcing channels, tools, outreach strategies, and approaches to improve candidate quality and engagement.
Relationship Building
Communicate directly with hiring leaders up to C-Suite as well as cross functional partners in other departments, including but not limited to People Operations, Legal, Marketing, Engineering, Sales, Product, etc.
Serves as a strategic partner for executives.
Bring a collaborative and solutions-oriented approach to working with hiring teams and candidates.
Process Improvement
Help create a recruiting environment that is thoughtful, high-performing, efficient, and scalable without losing the human element of recruiting.
Provide recruiting insights and recommendations to Talent Acquisition and senior leadership.
Use recruiting data and talent-market insights to improve candidate quality, sourcing effectiveness, hiring efficiency, and candidate experience.
Identify opportunities to improve how we attract, assess, and close talent.

4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, in-house or agency.
Experience recruiting for technical roles, including Engineering, Data, Product, and AI/ML.
Startup experience strongly preferred; comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
Proven experience sourcing passive candidates and filling hard-to-fill technical roles.
Experience partnering directly with hiring managers on intake, candidate profiles, sourcing strategy, timelines, and compensation.
Track record of meeting individual recruiting goals and managing a healthy recruiting funnel.
Experience using recruiting data and market feedback to adjust sourcing and hiring strategy.
Comfortable managing multiple searches and stakeholders while owning the process from intake through close.
Experience with recruiting tools and ATS platforms (Greenhouse a plus); able to quickly learn new systems.
Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%
Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.

Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.
The base salary range for this role is between $80,000 - $100,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.
Why Talkspace?
Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health.

According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all.

Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.
Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable.

Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space.

If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!
